api.train: train(study_dir=None, data_dir=None) -> final_decision dictionary; does not evaluate test scores
api.test_once: test_once(study_dir=None, data_dir=None) -> sealed final_test dictionary; later calls return existing result without new predictions

validation_scores.csv: Validation metadata plus score_CONFIGURATION for all four ensembles and score_original_cnn, score_radar_statistics, score_majority

final_decision.json.selected_configuration: One of baseline, history, hard_negatives, nonlinear_head
final_decision.json.evaluated_test_models: Chosen configuration, majority, original_cnn, radar_statistics, baseline; names deduplicated
final_decision.json.thresholds: Object mapping each evaluated model to its validation-chosen float threshold; majority has null
final_decision.json.majority_prediction: Integer 0 or 1 chosen from training class counts; ties select 0
final_decision.json.chosen_best_epochs: Object mapping seed string to its selected epoch
final_decision.json.validation_metrics: Object mapping evaluated model name to metric object described below
final_decision.json.data_audit: Object keyed train/validation/test with clips, positive_clips, storm_groups, positive_storm_groups, warning_negative_clips, warning_negative_storm_groups
final_decision.json.input_fingerprint: Object with sha256 and hashes of config/manifest/provenance/sample IDs/features/pretrained checkpoint
final_decision.json.model_artifact_hashes: Paths relative to results mapped to SHA-256
final_decision.json.environment: Python, platform, package versions, training_device and torch_threads
final_decision.json.training_wall_seconds: Train/validation wall time excluding input loading and prior feature extraction

final_test.json.selected_configuration: Name chosen before any test scores were inspected
final_test.json.evaluated_models: List of predeclared tested model names
final_test.json.metrics: Object mapping model name to metric object
final_test.json.bootstrap: 1000 paired draws of whole storm groups with seed 42

final_test_predictions.csv: All runtime manifest columns for test rows, plus score_MODEL and prediction_MODEL for each evaluated model
notes: Undefined metric values are null in JSON and empty cells in CSV
AP intervals are undefined for draws without any positive targets
BCE training loss is weighted; validation BCE is unweighted
Each adaptation compares directly with baseline; experiments are not cumulative
No new real-data training result is represented by this schema file
